name: bunpm-repo
description: Repo-level tooling for bunpm. The published package lives in bunpm/ and has zero dependencies — eslint and prettier are declared here so they never ship to end users, because bootstrap.js downloads bunpm/package.json onto their machines.

scripts.check-syntax: node --check bunpm/core/wrapper.js && node --check bunpm/core/mapper.js && node --check bunpm/core/formatter.js && node --check bunpm/core/detector.js && node --check bunpm/core/platform-detect.js && node --check bunpm/core/errors.js && node --check bunpm/core/validate-args.js && node --check bunpm/bootstrap.js
